title: Just the export
skill: Set the scope: say what not to change

good: Create one new file, src/export/csv.js, that exports toCSV(rows, columns). Rules: first line is the column names joined by commas; then one line per row with the values in column order (missing values are empty); a value that contains a comma, a double quote or a newline is wrapped in double quotes, with each inner double quote doubled; numbers are written with String(n); lines are joined with \n and there is no newline at the end. Do not change or refactor any existing file, including src/index.js and src/report.js. Then run: node --test test/*.test.js
lazy: Add a CSV export for the order report.
